query: What reasons or compliance risks appear in declined expenses?

per_column.name: asset_category_type
per_column.rationale: Describes what kind of asset the expense concerns, not a reason or compliance risk category for the decline. It is an attribute of the expense item, a potential correlate of decline, not a facet of the decline reason itself.

per_column.name: asset_hardware_subtype
per_column.rationale: Finer-grained asset taxonomy; an attribute of the purchased item, not an aspect of why the expense was declined.

per_column.name: entry_origin
per_column.rationale: Manual vs auto entry is a provenance attribute that may predict data-quality issues, but it is not itself a constitutive facet of the decline reason.

per_column.name: source_id_present
per_column.rationale: Presence of a source id is a completeness/data-quality signal that may correlate with a decline, not an aspect of the reason for decline.

per_column.name: vendor_brand
per_column.rationale: Vendor identity is an attribute of the expense, not a component of the decline reason.

per_column.name: is_premium_or_luxury_item
per_column.rationale: A flag that could be a policy-violation trigger, but it characterizes the item, not a facet decomposing the decline-reason concept.

per_column.name: is_travel_category_hardware_mismatch
per_column.rationale: This directly encodes a specific compliance-risk/reason type (category mismatch) that is genuinely an aspect of why an expense might be declined, so it partially realizes the concept.

per_column.name: ci_name_quality
per_column.rationale: A data-quality attribute of the CI naming; a possible correlate of declines, not a constitutive facet of the decline reason itself.

judge.rationale: The concept to decompose is the set of REASONS / compliance risks behind declined expenses. Almost all added columns describe attributes of the expense item (asset type, subtype, vendor, luxury flag) or data-provenance/quality signals (entry origin, source_id presence, ci name quality). These are external predictors or correlates of a decline, not constitutive parts of the decline-reason concept itself. Only is_travel_category_hardware_mismatch encodes an actual reason/compliance-risk type and thus qualifies as a genuine facet. With just one facet present, the set fails to cover the main reason categories (policy violation, budget/amount limits, missing documentation, duplicate, unauthorized approver, etc.), giving very low exhaustiveness. Mutual exclusivity is low-to-moderate because several non-facet columns redundantly capture overlapping data-quality/provenance signals; among the facets there is effectively only one, so overlap is trivially limited but the overall carve is poor.
